production.note: US model years. Start: AutoGuide (Michael Accardi, 24 February 2017), headline "2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE is Basically a Z/28"; Car and Driver's road-test panel is titled "2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE" (source cd-camaro-zl1-1le-2018). End: GM Authority's 2024 Camaro specification table still lists the ZL1 1LE, "Curb weight with 1LE Manual (lbs. / kg)" with "3853 / 1748" in the ZL1 column (source gmauthority-camaro-2024-specs), and GM Authority's 2024 Camaro page states "The 2024 Camaro is the last production year for the internal combustion powered model." (source gmauthority-camaro-2024). Kept as its own record (like the 5th-gen Z/28): the 1LE is ordered as a package on the ZL1, but it changes the car substantially (manual-only at launch, aero, suspension, tyres) and is widely treated as a distinct model; the owner may fold it into a ZL1 record instead.

body.note: Panel: "front-engine, rear-wheel-drive, 4-passenger, 2-door coupe". Coupe only: GM Authority's 2024 table prints "N/A" for the 1LE rows in the ZL1 Convertible column (source gmauthority-camaro-2024-specs).

configuration.note: LT4. Panel: "supercharged and intercooled pushrod 16-valve V-8, aluminum block and heads, direct fuel injection".

fuel.note: Inferred from the panel's engine line (direct-injected V-8, no hybrid system).

transmission.note: 2018 panel: "TRANSMISSION 6-speed manual". At launch the manual was the only gearbox: AutoGuide, "it will only be available with a six-speed manual" (source autoguide-zl1-1le-2018). The 10-speed automatic was added later: Car and Driver's 2019 ZL1 1LE panel reads "TRANSMISSION 10-speed automatic" (source cd-camaro-zl1-1le-2019), and GM Authority's 2024 table has both "Curb weight with 1LE Manual" and "Curb weight with 1LE Auto" rows for the ZL1 (source gmauthority-camaro-2024-specs). The automatic is a torque-converter unit.

powerHp.note: Car and Driver road-test panel, 2018 ZL1 1LE manual. Quote: "Power 650 hp @ 6400 rpm". The 2019 automatic panel prints the same "650 hp @ 6400 rpm" (source cd-camaro-zl1-1le-2019); AutoGuide: "The ZL1 1LE retains its 650-horsepower, supercharged LT4 V8" (source autoguide-zl1-1le-2018). Same rating as the ZL1 throughout the run.

weightLb.note: Car and Driver road-test curb weight, 2018 ZL1 1LE coupe with the 6-speed manual (the standard car; base $71,295, as tested $72,595). Quote: "Curb weight: 3842 lb". Other figures: Car and Driver's 2019 automatic panel, "Curb weight: 3886 lb" (source cd-camaro-zl1-1le-2019); GM Authority's 2024 table, ZL1 column, "Curb weight with 1LE Manual (lbs. / kg)" "3853 / 1748" and "Curb weight with 1LE Auto (lbs. / kg)" "3883 / 1761" (source gmauthority-camaro-2024-specs). See discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Model year and method: 3,842 lb is Car and Driver's road-test curb weight for a 2018 manual car; 3,853 lb is the manual ZL1 1LE in GM Authority's specification table for the 2024 model. They differ by 11 lb (0.3%). The automatic figures agree the same way (C/D 2019: 3,886 lb; GM Authority 2024: 3,883 lb).
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,842 lb: the step-2 figure for the reference model year (2018), per the owner's rule on Car and Driver road-test curb weights. No GM table for 2018 could be opened.
